say:2:1830134001:1.text: Don't even get me started. Sure, some places offer Lightbearer cuisine, but it's nothing to write home about.
say:2:1830134001:1.source_cn: 别提了，这里根本没有美食。顶多能吃到一些从耀光传过来的...

say:3:1830134002:0.text: We had this Lightbearer-style beef stew yesterday, but all I could taste was preservatives.
say:3:1830134002:0.source_cn: 昨天吃了一道据说传自耀光的红酒炖牛肉，吃起来全是防腐香...

say:4:1830134003:1.text: Hey, cut those Graveborn chefs some slack. They've been dead for so long, they've forgotten the right way to make it.
say:4:1830134003:1.source_cn: 算了吧，这里的厨子都是亡灵。死了那么久了，做法早就走样了。

say:5:1830134004:1.text: I miss home. I'd take a hot pie from a Lightbearer street stall over anything here.
say:5:1830134004:1.source_cn: 我想回耀光了。哪怕街边一块热乎的肉馅饼，也比这里强。

say:6:1830134005:1.text: *Sigh* I can barely remember what freshly baked bread tastes like anymore...
say:6:1830134005:1.source_cn: 唉，在这里待久了，我都快忘了刚出炉的面包是什么味道了……
